proposal.summary: Open source DataEase datasource deserialization vulnerability allows arbitrary code execution prior to version 1.18.7; fixed in v1.18.7. No known workarounds other than upgrading.
proposal.affected_product: DataEase datasource (before v1.18.7); fixed in v1.18.7
proposal.recommended_next_step: Upgrade to v1.18.7 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

evidence_quotes.claim: Deserialization vulnerability leading to arbitrary code execution in the DataEase datasource prior to v1.18.7
evidence_quotes.quote: Prior to version 1.18.7, a deserialization vulnerability exists in the DataEase datasource, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary code.
The vulnerability has been fixed in v1.18.7.
